title: How To Start Day Trading As A Beginner In 2026 (FULL GUIDE)
summary: Beginner day-trading road map: paper trade first, learn support/resistance and VWAP, a gap-and-go VWAP strategy, and keep your job because beginners lose money for years.

assertions.quote: if you're brand new to trading, you are most likely going to lose money first
please make sure you learn from a mistake and paper trade first
the more times in the past these support or resistance levels have been tested, the more powerful they should be

verdicts.note: Some evidence of clustering at round numbers and prior extremes, but technical levels have weak predictive power out of sample.

assertions.quote: If a stock is trading above VWAP, especially when it's pulling really far away from it, it is perceived by traders as really bullish

verdicts.note: VWAP describes the day's average fill; it is widely watched but has little documented edge as a signal.

assertions.quote: The idea of the strategy is to focus on trading stocks that have gapped up on the day and continuing to trend up higher.

verdicts.note: Intraday momentum effects exist in some studies but there is no independent evidence this setup beats costs for retail traders.

assertions.quote: it took me over two years to become consistently profitable

verdicts.note: Self-reports of multi-year learning curves are typical, and most never reach profitability at all.

Panel regressions on 1,551 traders with 300+ trading days find no learning: expected profit stays negative and does not improve with time, so keeping a day job is supported but years of practice do not reliably bring profitability.

assertions.quote: there's just tons of free resources online
